abstract.para: The &hawk; Wizards help you configure resources, from simple resources like a virtual IP address to complex configurations like a &drbd; block device or an Apache Web server. The wizard guides you through the configuration steps and provides information about the parameters you need to enter.

step.para: In a Web browser, go to https://HAWKSERVER:7630/ and log in.
From the left navigation bar, select ConfigurationWizards.
Select the wizard you want to use. You can expand the different categories by clicking the down arrow icons.
Follow the instructions on the screen. &hawk; shows a description for each parameter.
If the wizard has more than one step, click Next to go to the next step.
After the last step, click Verify. &hawk; shows a list of the actions it will perform, and what the configuration will look like.
Click Apply. Depending on the configuration, you might be prompted for the &rootuser; password.
The list of steps turns green if the configuration was applied successfully.
